brief: Crews must apply the loading restrictions in MG-021 for Northcott Bend 230/34kV (SUB-SGW-518) in preference to accepting thermal exposure ahead of the forecast heat event. As specified in MG-023, this unit's age in service of 24 years with a cooling type of ONAN requires prioritization for pre-event attention and loading restriction. The supplied documents do not cover any specific additional actions for this asset beyond these loading and prioritization measures.
